description: Two Issue Radar crews for an SDK team: the labels, the review rules and the models to enter in Radar. A pack creates no crew.

crews.prompt: For any issue with an <!-- avoozl --> marker, run `avoozl verify-issue OWNER/REPO#N` (or the plans_verify_issue tool) first; build only if it exits 0, otherwise skip it with scope needs-decision and say which check failed.
crews.reviewRules:
- Build only from an issue that came from an approved spec. If the check fails, skip the issue.
- Open one pull request per issue, and name the issue in it with `Closes #N`.
- Say what you skipped or did not check.
